alerts.header: Media-Sharon Hill Line is Now the “D”
alerts.description: The Media-Sharon Hill Line is now the “D” as part of system-wide wayfinding improvements. The 101 is the D1, and the 102 is the D2. Expect to see both old and new language used through the transition. Learn more at septa.org/metro.

alerts.description: The Norristown High Speed Line is now the “M” as part of system-wide wayfinding improvements. Expect to see both old and new language used through the transition. Learn more at septa.org/metro.

alerts.header: Potential Delays due to Amtrak Infrastructure Project
alerts.description: Due to an Amtrak infrastructure project near William H. Gray III 30th St Station: Paoli/Thorndale, Cynwyd, Trenton, Chestnut Hill West, Fox Chase and West Trenton trains may experience delays of up to 10 minutes through early November. Please plan for added travel time. SEPTA apologizes for the inconvenience.

alerts.header: Shuttle Busing Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St Stations
alerts.description: Bus service replaces trains from Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St stations on November 7-8. Riders should allow an additional 10-15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit septa.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate  Manayunk/Norristown Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.header: Marcus Hook, Glenolden, Norwood Stations Discontinue Fare Product Sales
alerts.description: Due to a wide array of alternate purchase options, sales at Marcus Hook, Glenolden and Norwood stations are discontinued, effective close of business November 20. Registered SEPTA Key Card holders (includes SEPTA Key Senior Fare, SEPTA Key Reduced Fare and CCT holders) continue to have access to the waiting areas of the stations. During designated times, waiting areas are open for seating, restrooms and other amenities.

alerts.header: West Trenton Station Waiting Room Closed
alerts.description: Due to vandalism, the waiting room at West Trenton Station is closed until further notice. Report problems using the SEPTA App (available for iOS and Android); the “Help” tab lets you discreetly report incidents or suspicious activity in seconds.

alerts.header: No Parking in North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station
alerts.description: The North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station is closed for stormwater and restoration work until further notice.
New Regional Rail schedules went into effect on Sunday, October 18. Visit septa.org for schedule update highlights and new PDFs schedules for each impacted line.

alerts.header: Outbound Platform Boarding from Noble to Neshaminy Falls Stations
alerts.description: On weekdays from Monday, October 26 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Noble to Neshaminy Falls stations.
On weekdays from Monday, October 26 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platform at Jenkintown-Wyncote Station.

alerts.header: Outbound Platform Boarding from Noble to Neshaminy Falls Stations
alerts.description: From 11 pm on Friday, November 6 through Sunday, November 8, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Noble to Neshaminy Falls stations.

alerts.header: Reduced Parking Spots at Bryn Mawr Station
alerts.description: Due to Amtrak substation upgrades at Bryn Mawr Station, 19 spots in the parking lot are unavailable until further notice. Check for posted signs at the station lot.

alerts.header: Chestnut Hill East Station Parking Lot Update
alerts.description: Only 18 parking spots (including 1 ADA spot) are designated for customers on East Chestnut Hill Ave., alongside the South lot. Additionally, no overnight parking is allowed at Chestnut Hill East Station until construction is completed.

alerts.header: North Philadelphia Station Platform Fare Validators Out of Service
alerts.description: Due to Amtrak construction work, the Trenton Line platform validators at North Philadelphia Station are out of service. Regional Rail riders who are boarding/exiting at this station should seek conductor assistance in opening/closing their trips to avoid overcharges. Riders who experience fare overcharges related to this outage can submit disputes online at SEPTAKey.org or by phone with agents at the Key Call Center (1-855-56-SEPTA).

alerts.header: Outbound Platform Boarding, Train #207, Norristown Transit Center
alerts.description: Every weekday until further notice, passengers must board inbound Train #207 departing at 5:50 am on the outbound platform at Norristown Transit Center.
